name: codex-autoresume
description: Detect Codex sessions that stopped on a usage limit (5-hour or weekly) and automatically resume them when the limit resets.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-resume work after a usage limit
interface.longDescription: Reads local Codex session logs to find sessions that stopped on a usage limit, waits for the exact reset time, then continues the same session with `codex exec resume`. Includes a background watcher, start-at-login support and a skill that sets it all up.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Codex sessions are stalled on a usage limit right now?
Set up auto-resume so my work continues after the 5-hour limit resets.
Show what the auto-resume watcher has resumed so far.
